targetInputs.label: Ignite Armor tank swap stacks
targetInputs.tooltip: Taunt swap when the current tank reaches this many Ignite Armor stacks. Set to 0 to disable simulated tank swaps.

targetInputs.label: Swap back when Ignite Armor expires
targetInputs.tooltip: Automatically swap back to the main tank when Ignite Armor expires on the main tank. If disabled, swap after stacks build up on the off-tank.
